name: Recruited Assassin

skills.name: Dual Blade Strike
skills.description: (Basic Attack) Deals physical DMG 2 times. Melee range 1-1.

skills.name: Counterattack
skills.description: (Reaction) When hit by active attack from front or side, performs basic attack if attacker in range, up to 1/round.

skills.name: Hunting Impulse
skills.description: (Physical DMG) Single-target. Crit increases before attack. If target defeated, recovers 3 NRG. Melee 1-1.

skills.name: Hookshot
skills.description: (Debuff) Selects 1 enemy in cross range, drags to self, inflicts debuff 1 turn. Range 1-4.

skills.name: Fancy Footwork
skills.description: (Support) Takes less AoE DMG and gains dodge attempts for turns.

summary: Rare assassin with pull (Hookshot) and multi-hit basic.
